d.ko: Welcome to Taoyuan Village to heal your loneliness. Here, you can lead a carefree, self-sufficient life: farm, tame animals, raise livestock, fish, and build a prosperous homestead. Or, immerse in village life, meet kindred spirits, find love, and influence their destinies with your choices.
d.en: Welcome to Taoyuan Village to heal your loneliness. Here, you can lead a carefree, self-sufficient life: farm, tame animals, raise livestock, fish, and build a prosperous homestead. Or, immerse in village life, meet kindred spirits, find love, and influence their destinies with your choices.
d.zh: 欢迎来到桃源村，治愈你的孤独感。在这里，你可以选择悠然自得的逍遥人生，通过自力更生——种地、驯兽、畜牧、钓鱼……逐步打造自己的繁荣农庄。也可以选择融入人群，结交挚友，寻获爱侣，通过自己的努力影响他们的命运。
